tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250dngos grub len pa ni/1$0000300 oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings phyogs lhung bral ba'i dkyil 'khor du: snang ba mtha' yas 'chi med tshe yi bdag: gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'od gsal rang shar rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: tshe dpag med mgon 'chi med tshe yi bdag: gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: pad+ma 'dab stong rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor du: o rgyan pad+ma 'chi med tshe yi bdag: gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde chen 'od gsal mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// bai ro tsa na 'chi med tshe yi bdag /gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zab lam smin grol chos kyi dkyil 'khor du// gter bdag gling pa 'chi med tshe yi bdag /gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ las rlung dhū tir dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du// rtsa ba'i bla ma 'chi med tshe yi bdag /gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag la: gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā:

zhes gsol 'debs tshe dzap dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing*/ slar yang sgrub rdzas rnams gnas gsum du reg cing*/ oṃ/ bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon gyis// sku yi tshe dbang bdag la stsol// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sku /mgon po khyod dang mnyam par shog /kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ āḥ bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon gyis// gsung gi tshe dbang bdag la stsol// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gsung*// mgon po khyod dang mnyam par shog /wā ka sid+dhi āḥ hūm̐/ bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon gyis// thugs kyi tshe dbang bdag la stsol// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i thugs// mgon po khyod dang mnyam par shog /tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ tshe zan g.yas skor dang tshe chang g.yon skor du rol la/ slar yang*/ oṃ bha ga wa te ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ hrī: chos dbyings ngang las rang byung rang shar ba'i: mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: sems ma bzhi dang mgyogs ma chen mo bzhi: sgo srung bzhi sogs 'khor dang bcas la bstod: zhes bstod/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang: sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// sogs kyis bstim/ med na/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs/ a: skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' bral don gyi lhar: gshegs bzhugs dngos po'i mtshan mas dben mod kyi: 'on kyang rang gsal ma 'gags snang stong gzhi: skye med thugs srog nā da'i dbyings su bsdu: badz+ra mu: zhes dam tshig pa bsdu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas// sogs kyis dge ba bsngo/ rang bzhin chos dbyings ngang nyid las: gzugs sku'i rnam rol dpag yas kyis: rlabs chen phrin las skyong mdzad pa'i: brgyud gsum bla ma'i bkra shis shog: ma 'gags rang gsal 'od lnga'i klong:

rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes: mchog thun dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i: yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog: phyogs bcu gnas yul sprul pa'i zhing: phrin las rnam bzhi'i rol gar mkhan: mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis: bkra shis bde legs bstsal du gsol: zhes sogs bkra shis rgya cher brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// //
